fields.id: stable key; equals cursor except for folded rows (fold:telemetry_stall)
fields.cursor: ref of the event: <source>:<byte offset of its line>
fields.t_s: seconds on the run clock, null before the clock starts
fields.seq: per-file sequence number from the envelope
fields.kind: card to draw, one of kinds
fields.title: short single line
fields.pair: tool_use_id linking a tool call with its result, else null
fields.fold: null, or {group, pairs, open, total_paused_s, ...} on a folded row
